engineeringConstructionHolds.subject: Vessel service/flag/class/tonnage and rule applicability
engineeringConstructionHolds.required: Agree statutory/class basis, tonnage calculation and passenger/vehicle service requirements

engineeringConstructionHolds.subject: Weight, trim and stability
engineeringConstructionHolds.required: Resolve 86.40053 t difference between conditional 289.010 t schedule and 375.41053 t retained waterline buoyancy; verified mass/CoG, trimmed hydrostatics, GZ, downflooding and intact/damage cases

engineeringConstructionHolds.subject: Structure and fabricated tanks
engineeringConstructionHolds.required: Scantlings, materials, weld details, frame/foundation calculations; tank partition/access/vent/suction and calibrated net capacities. Concept reserves are not fabricated volumes

engineeringConstructionHolds.subject: Machinery installation and shaft line
engineeringConstructionHolds.required: Actual OEM duty and period identity, certified outlines/masses/CoG, mounts/bolt/nozzle data; propeller/thrust/alignment/bearings/torsional vibration and fatigue

engineeringConstructionHolds.subject: Human access, overhaul and removal
engineeringConstructionHolds.required: Resolve 1.9 m nominal headroom versus 2.0 m yard route target and 0.25 m overhead reservation; engineer full protected escape, removable hatches, lifting points and certified lift plan

engineeringConstructionHolds.subject: Piping and service performance
engineeringConstructionHolds.required: Resolve 151 unsupported/missing/obstructed positive-DN connections; actual nozzle ownership, insulation/wall/bends/supports, hull/fire/watertight penetrations; hydraulic, cooling, air, exhaust, ventilation and fire-suppression calculations

engineeringConstructionHolds.subject: Electrical physical installation
engineeringConstructionHolds.required: OEM generator/transformer/motor/cable data, fault duties/coordination, group/thermal installation, complete voltage drops, DC inventory/battery endurance and emergency generator dynamics. Fire-pump scenario 52.5 kVA exceeds 40 kVA continuous rating but transient behaviour is unknown
